current_state.fact: Frontend currently has Playwright E2E coverage via frontend/playwright.config.cjs and ./scripts/run_e2e.sh.
No frontend unit/integration coverage tool is currently defined in frontend/package.json; this packet declares Jest/Next as the canonical runner family for that gap.
The explicit target of this packet is line coverage for source files under frontend/app, frontend/components, and frontend/lib.

local_adaptation.rule: For this project, Playwright is the canonical frontend E2E/live-interaction verifier.
For this project, Jest with Next-compatible setup is the canonical frontend unit/integration and coverage runner for frontend/app, frontend/components, and frontend/lib.
This adaptation is controller-owned; workers MUST NOT substitute another unit/integration runner unless the controller updates this packet.

objective.goal: Establish execution-ready frontend test hardening work that reaches and enforces 95% line coverage for the scoped frontend source while preserving the current Playwright E2E path.
objective.business_value: Reduce frontend regression risk in high-traffic user and admin flows, make coverage measurable and enforceable, and give coder workers a bounded implementation path.

coverage_metric.definition: Line coverage must be at least 95.00% for the union of instrumented source files under frontend/app, frontend/components, and frontend/lib.
coverage_metric.formula: (covered executable lines in included scoped source files) / (all executable lines in included scoped source files) * 100
coverage_metric.numerator_rule: E2E files do not contribute covered lines to the numerator because E2E specs are excluded from the instrumented source set.
coverage_metric.denominator_rule: Only executable lines in included source files inside the three scoped directories count in the denominator.

reporting_requirements.requirement: Coverage output MUST report a combined scoped line percentage.
Coverage output SHOULD also report per-file line coverage to guide remediation waves.
Coverage evidence MUST be reproducible from committed config and documented commands.

policy_decisions.decision: Generated files MUST be excluded from the scoped coverage denominator and numerator.
All unit, integration, harness, fixture, and helper test files MUST be excluded from the scoped coverage denominator and numerator.
All Playwright E2E specs and support files under frontend/e2e MUST be excluded from the scoped coverage denominator and numerator.
All snapshots and snapshot baselines MUST be excluded from the scoped coverage denominator and numerator.

generated_file_rule.requirement: If the chosen coverage tool surfaces framework-generated artifacts, workers MUST explicitly exclude them in config.
If a file’s generated/manual status is ambiguous, treat it as excluded until the controller explicitly marks it in-scope.

wave.name: audit-baseline
wave.purpose: Establish the current source inventory, the current coverage baseline, and the largest uncovered areas.

wave.name: tool-stabilization
wave.purpose: Add and stabilize a Jest/Next unit/integration coverage runner that works alongside existing Playwright E2E tooling.

wave.name: high-value-tests
wave.purpose: Add high-value unit/integration tests that cover behavior-rich files first and lift scoped line coverage toward target.

wave.name: threshold-enforcement
wave.purpose: Make the 95% scoped line threshold enforceable in CI/local verification and fail closed on regressions.

wave.name: docs-handoff
wave.purpose: Document commands, scope, exclusions, and worker handoff rules so future coder workers can continue without rediscovery.

write_scope.rule: Workers MAY add tests, lightweight testing utilities, and minimal source refactors needed to make critical logic testable.
Workers MUST keep implementation changes tightly coupled to testability or defect fixes exposed by the new tests.

frozen_scope.rule: Do not broaden this slice into backend behavior, billing runtime changes, or unrelated UI redesign.
E2E updates are allowed only if required to keep existing quick verification green after harmless frontend refactors; they do not count toward the 95% metric.

verification_commands.verification_note: ./scripts/run_e2e.sh* remains the canonical Playwright E2E/live-interaction verifier for frontend behavior.
npm run test:coverage* is the canonical Jest/Next unit/integration and coverage verifier for scoped frontend source.
The last two commands are packet-defined targets that implementation workers MUST create if they do not already exist.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A committed Jest/Next frontend coverage tool exists and can run from /opt/astro-project/frontend without relying on Playwright browsers.
The tool reports scoped line coverage for frontend/app + frontend/components + frontend/lib with explicit exclusions for generated files, test files, E2E files, and snapshots.
Measured scoped line coverage is at least 95.00%.
The threshold command fails non-zero when scoped line coverage falls below 95.00%.
Existing required quick verification remains documented: backend quick plus frontend E2E quick.
Packet docs are sufficient for a coder worker to execute the work without rediscovering scope, commands, or acceptance boundaries.
